method: Same board and firmware. Performance A, weather, home, performance B. Six samples per window, about 24 seconds; 65-second warmup for restored performance page. Existing visible animation and services remain active.
cpu_normalization: 100% is both P4 cores combined; scheduler estimates use a 100 Hz sampling clock and 2-second time constant

findings.sd_card_bus: SPI3 at configured 20 MHz; SPI3 DMA disabled; current PIO exchange batches at most 64 bytes and busy-waits
findings.file_cache: FAT per-file partial-sector buffer; driver read-ahead disabled; no multi-frame loop cache in player
findings.network: 10 ms daemon sleep, four CMD52 accesses per empty length query, busy-wait response in SDMMC; no empty-poll or function-duration counter in current firmware
findings.display: LVGL DIRECT with two drawing buffers and dirty regions; framebuffer driver flushes the union of prior/current dirty rows for both drawing buffers; software rendering
findings.existing_caches: Weather decoded scene/frost and TTF glyph caches already exist
findings.memory: Latest sample: PSRAM heap free 29093712 bytes; internal kernel heap free 16608 bytes, largest block 15776 bytes; static boot-layout margin remains 132 bytes

recommendations.change: Bounded reclaimable frame cache with lazy filling and stream fallback; reuse frames without changing sequence or live gaze; avoid duplicate caching if a shared file cache is introduced
Evaluate DMA plus completion semaphore, including aligned bounded bounce buffers and static-memory budget; enabling the flag alone is insufficient

recommendations.layer: Hosted network transport and SDIO host
recommendations.change: Measure empty-poll count and real command time, then implement event wake plus budgeted active draining and timeout fallback; preserve RPC receive ownership
Profile invalid area and cache writeback sizes; retain layer contents and narrow dirty-region work while preserving buffer synchronization
Gate verbose RPC hex output; preserve errors and on-demand diagnostics

modern_os_principles.topic: Retained display lists and dirty invalidation

limitations: These are tick-sampled thread estimates, not cycle-accurate function attribution. A 10ms poll and 100Hz sampling may have phase bias.
Thread CPU medians and total CPU are separately sampled and need not sum exactly.
Read-path mean includes card I/O, scheduler preemption and gaze work; it is wall time, not exclusive CPU time.
Visible floating pet moves and rests naturally; A/B redraw counts differ and cannot isolate pet cost.
RX delta is the transport accumulator modulo 1MiB, including RPC; it is not an empty-poll ratio or Ethernet throughput measurement.
NSH register timing returned 0 or 10ms and includes diagnostics; insufficient for individual CMD52 costs.
No optimization savings are claimed before implementation and controlled validation.
